annotations.title: Live US FDA openFDA food, drug, and medical device enforcement recal

description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Queries official US FDA openFDA enforcement feeds across food, drug, or medical device recalls, returning recall numbers, Class I/II/III severity, recalling firms, product descriptions, and reasons.

limit.description: Maximum number of recall records to return (1 to 10, default 5).

query.description: Optional keyword filter across recall reason and product description (e.g., 'allergen', 'listeria').

name: fetch_openfda_recalls
